name: @jmcombs/pi-relay
description: Relay roles for Pi: run any Pi subagent on an external coding agent (headless Claude Opus via `claude -p`, Grok Build via `grok -p`, or Cursor Agent via `cursor-agent -p`) through a provider seam, driven by the subagent's `model` field.
